reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing isEligibleForMonthAction predicate and parses the tag with the shared extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: The #fixed check is written once, but getMonthActionCategories now filters hidden/template both in its SQL and again through isEligibleForMonthAction, leaving those rules decided twice on that path.

placement.why: The group-note join is added to the two existing data queries and the rule to the shared eligibility predicate in budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: Production change is tight; the test file also gets prettier reformatting of unrelated assertions and an assertion on the SQL join itself.

maintainability.why: Every month-wide action now goes through one predicate, though the redundant SQL filters in getMonthActionCategories could drift from it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth (via getBudgetData rows) and the getMonthActionCategories actions both use isEligibleForMonthAction.

disguised_duplication.where: The leftover hidden/goal_def SQL conditions in getMonthActionCategories duplicate the predicate openly; no reshaped copy is introduced.

one_place.where: isEligibleForMonthAction in server/budget/actions.ts, now applied by copyPreviousMonth and by getMonthActionCategories (setZero, averages, last-month spending).
